prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1054; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on it yet, if that's okay. My attorney asked me to keep things limited until I've talked to her.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, in the right lane. I needed to move over to make my exit, so I checked my mirror and signaled.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you changed lanes?

A: Not really. I looked in my mirror and didn't see anything right beside me. I started moving over and then heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed.

Q: What happened after the impact?

A: The other car kept going for a second, then pulled over ahead. My car drifted toward the shoulder and I managed to stop. My airbags didn't deploy, but I hit my head on the window frame.

Q: Did you get checked by medical personnel at the scene?

A: An ambulance came. They asked me questions and I was confused about what day it was. They took me to the emergency room, where they diagnosed a concussion.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Still having headaches and trouble concentrating. I get tired fast, and bright screens make it worse. My doctor has me off work for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully. I just didn't see the other car in my blind spot, and I'd like the claim handled through my attorney going forward.
